info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_System Development Configuration API
info.description: The System Development Configuration API facilitates the modification of components within the IT management framework of banking services. This endpoint allows users to update critical settings and parameters associated with system development efforts, ensuring that configurations align with business requirements. Typical consumers include IT managers, system administrators, and developers involved in project delivery. Utilize this API to manage system development infrastructure effectively and adapt to evolving operational needs.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific System Development resource identified by its unique identifier. You can modify various attributes of the resource to keep it up-to-date with the latest information.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to update the existing resource with the identifier RES-100045 in the system development area of IT management. It requires a JSON formatted payload to provide the new values for the fields that need to be updated.
